newsitem.title: POLAND: Stalexport to vote on issue for EBRD.
newsitem.headline: Stalexport to vote on issue for EBRD.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish steel trader Stalexport SA will vote on May 31 on whether to issue one million to four million shares to the EBRD, Stalexport's spokesman said on Monday.
Jacek Czeladko told Reuters that the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (ERBD) had shown interest in buying shares worth $20 million to $25 million.

"If such a big international bank becomes a Stalexport shareholder then the prestige of our firm will certainly grow," Czeladko said. The bank's credit committee and board of directors still had to give final approval. @
Czeladko said the EBRD would buy the shares at no lower than 36.5 zlotys and that the price could increase depending on Stalexport's bourse performance in the coming weeks.
Stalexport closed on Friday at 33.8 zlotys.
Czeladko said the EBRD could approve the deal in June or July, allowing for an issue in September or October.
He said that as part of the deal the EBRD would also lend Stalexport another $20 million to $25 million over five to seven years. @
Czeladko said the funds from the issue and loans would go toward buying firms which collect and process scrap metal.
He added the company planned to invest 200 million zlotys by the end of the decade, with 120 million of it to be invested this year.
The company currently has a $50 million convertible bond listed in London.
